title: An EC private key with double-escaped newlines (JSON inside a JSON string) passes the leak scan
goal: The leak scan flags an EC private key whose line breaks are written as a doubled backslash and n, as in a JSONL record that embeds a JSON tool result

run:
import base64, os, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon
d = "-" * 5
arm = d + "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY" + d
b = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(96)).decode()
hit = lambda t: any(k == "secret" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t))
bs = chr(92)
t = arm + bs + bs + "n" + b[:64] + bs + bs + "n" + b[64:]
print("double-escaped key flagged:", hit(t))
sys.exit(0 if hit(t) else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-tsb23kev focused review of BG-3vnu37rq (reviewer session a419aba4) on origin/main 902e961a9; repro fails there. Premise 2026-10-23 on 35b5b7cb2: the repro exits 1 (double-escaped key flagged: False).
